summary: Iteration 10 (DecisionOS V1 expansion) tested end-to-end. Backend 23/23 NEW tests + 38/38 regression = 61/61 green. Frontend flows for CEO Brief, Notifications (bell + list + mark read + mark-all), Team Attendance toggle, People/Dealer type filter, Log Complaint dialog, My Work (mine=true tasks + Messages), Sales role gating (no toggle-absent, can log-complaint), mobile bottom-nav (Brief/Inbox/Work/Tasks/Ask) all working. Owner-alert email + WhatsApp are MOCKED (RESEND_API_KEY & WHATSAPP_API_KEY empty by design — logged only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1465 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth, contacts, workflows, brief, notifications, attendance, complaints, memory, files). Not blocking but recommended.
run_followup() correctly caps at escalation_level so repeated calls don't spam notifications — good. Owner-alert dispatch is idempotent per level bucket.
GET /api/files/{fname} is public by design (no auth) — verified working. Path traversal is guarded ('/' or '..' in fname → 404). OK.
Attendance uses upsert with $setOnInsert for id/created_at — correct idempotent pattern.
Complaints role gate correctly rejects finance/production (403), allows owner+sales.
CEOBrief.js completed row uses data.completed_label — 'morning' shows 'completed yesterday', other periods 'completed (weekly|evening|monthly)'. Correct.
Bell/Bellicon component renders inside header (desktop) and mobile header — visible on both. On mobile screenshot the bell badge shows 8 unread.
Voice shortcut flow: reminder task created with source='reminder' and memory note stored; both appear in /api/brain/search?q=xyz under 'memory' array.
PATCH /api/complaints/{id}/resolve accepts owner+sales; verified 404 on unknown id (implicit via matched_count==0).
test_credentials: owner@sharma.com / sales@sharma.com / production@sharma.com / finance@sharma.com — all pw demo1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Test artifacts created via API (all prefixed TEST_): dealer contact, customer complaint(s), tasks with attachments, purchase workflows. Voice-note generated 'Kumar' reminder task + XYZ memory note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 fully green. New endpoints tested: /api/brief (period=morning|evening|weekly|monthly), /api/notifications (GET+read+read-all), /api/follow-up/run, /api/attendance (POST owner-only, GET), /api/complaints (POST owner+sales, GET, PATCH resolve), /api/memory (GET/POST), /api/tasks/{id}/attachment (multipart photo|voice), /api/files/{fname} (public serve), /api/contacts type=dealer. Frontend routes /brief, /notifications, /my-work verified. Mobile bottom nav: bottomnav-brief/inbox/my-work/tasks/ask. Owner-only voice-note ingest still enforced. Email digest + owner-alert email + WhatsApp remain MOCKED (RESEND_API_KEY & WHATSAPP_API_KEY empty). Demo seeded data means brief counters are non-zero (delayed=63, complaints growing per run). Register fresh tenant for isolation tests.
